scenes.headline: How LIMSSR scores a dive with a sense missing
scenes.sub: Action quality assessment that reasons about the gap instead of rebuilding it
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Clove! LIMSSR watches a dive or a skating routine and predicts the judge's score, even when video, flow or audio was never recorded. Here's how.

scenes.text: Don't rebuild a missing stream. Name it in a prompt, and let a language model reason about what the gap means.
scenes.say: The idea: don't rebuild a missing stream. Name it in a prompt, and let a language model reason about what the gap means. That works even when training data has holes.

items.say: Each stream, video frames, optical flow and audio, goes through a frozen feature extractor and a small projection.

items.text: A missing stream becomes a token
items.say: A missing stream isn't filled with zeros. It becomes a special token.
A text prompt tells the model which streams are present, and which are gone.
A frozen language model, tuned with LoRA, infers the missing stream's role from what remains.

steps.say: The scoring head runs two paths off the same missingness mask. One recovers cross-modal patterns: strong when streams are present, shaky when they're not.
The other is calibrated. It discounts what it can't trust, so it degrades gracefully.
A learnable confidence gate blends them. As streams drop, confidence falls, and weight shifts to the path that distrusts what it can't verify.

scenes.title: FS1000 Spearman rho, audio only
scenes.note: 1.0 is a perfect ordering, 0 is chance
scenes.say: With only audio, naive fusion falls to a rank correlation of point one seven seven. LIMSSR, told in words what's gone, holds point six eight seven.

scenes.text: Telling the model what it is missing beats trying to fake what it lost.

recap: A missing stream becomes a token and a prompt
A LoRA-tuned LLM reasons its way to a score
A confidence gate shifts to the cautious path
scenes.say: To recap: name the gap, let the language model reason, and gate away guesses it can't verify.
